rationale: mx.fast.rope accepts an ARRAY offset for per-sequence positions, added in MLX 0.30.0. Older knowledge only has the integer offset, forcing a per-sequence Python loop. Both are correct; only one is a single fused call.
note: The grader's reference is a per-batch loop, so a looping solution passes on correctness. This task discriminates on whether the model knows the array-offset API, which shows up as tokens and search count, not pass rate.
